domain: witnessed-transaction (distributed-transaction close semantics x pre-modern rite-of-passage) -- the status crossing that is simultaneously a fenced/idempotent/compensable transaction AND a witnessed three-phase status-rite
axioms: TENSION (unresolved, this lens's home): the orchestration frame treats a status crossing as a TRANSACTION and its favorite fixes -- at-least-once retry, idempotent replay, provisional-accept-then-async-verify, silent single-writer fencing -- each either MANUFACTURE an intermediate state or HIDE it from witnesses; the rite frame treats the same crossing as a RITE whose central hazard IS an intermediate state (the stranded liminal subject belonging to neither status) and whose validity requires a witnessed, ordered, all-the-way-through, community-attested passage. One frame wants the in-between made safe-and-invisible; the other wants it made visible-and-resolved. A crossing can be transactionally correct yet leave a subject socially stranded or un-witnessed; a crossing can be ritually valid yet have no fence, no checkpoint, no compensation protecting its witness. This lens lives exactly on that seam and does not resolve it.

Every status crossing in the redesign is ONE object with two obligations at once: it must survive interruption/concurrency/retry/late-verification-failure as a transaction, AND confer a witnessed, ordered, non-polluting new status as a rite -- and the sharpest defects are where satisfying one obligation violates the other.

A mechanism that makes the transaction correct can be the mechanism that makes the rite invalid: idempotent replay re-confers a status onto an already-reincorporated subject (double-status); provisional-accept strands the subject in the liminal margin during async verify; a compensating revert becomes a silently-reverting conferral the community already witnessed downstream.

A mechanism that makes the rite valid can lack any transactional guarantee protecting its witness: an un-fenced witnessed reincorporation (the Goal-entity close write) lets two sessions each perform a valid-looking crossing, double-minting or double-discharging one Goal; a witnessed status with no per-step checkpoint cannot resume the remaining phases of an interrupted terminal rite.

Session-scoped completion (/goal-met) and goal-scoped completion (Goal-entity close) are different cardinalities AND different rites: collapsing them fires the goal-level reincorporation from a session-level separation -- a phase-skip that reincorporates a many-run goal on the strength of one session ending.

An optional consumer of a close event is neither an enforcement mechanism (orchestration) NOR a binding final phase (rite): making the mandatory successor-proposal a best-effort unordered consumer leaves the passage closed-yet-unfinished, its final witness un-fired.

Concurrent chain cohorts with no fence and no resolution ceremony strand the in-flight cohort: the strategized-collapse separates in-flight runs from a retired chain without reincorporating them into the new one, leaving polluting double-/no-status runs the goal-cadence hook mis-reads.

HARD CONSTRAINT: report a finding ONLY if it requires BOTH parent perspectives -- every finding must name a transactional mechanism (fence/idempotency/provisional-accept/compensation/checkpoint/consumer-optionality/consistency-window) AND a rite consequence (stranded subject / missing-separation double-status / un-witnessed or silently-reverting conferral / phase-skip / hollow witness / polluting half-crossing with no resolution rite), with an intersection_justification showing that deleting either half collapses the finding into a single-parent concern.
primitives: witnessed-transaction: a status crossing crossed with BOTH its transactional guarantees (fence, idempotency, checkpoint, compensation) and its rite obligations (separation-before-reincorporation, ordered phases, durable witness, no stranded subject, resolution rite)
idempotency-manufactures-double-status: at-least-once replay of a terminal step re-confers a status onto an already-reincorporated subject, or replays a reincorporation whose separation already ran

provisional-accept strands-the-subject: accept-then-async-verify leaves the Goal witnessed-closed during the verify window; the compensating revert is a silently-reverting conferral the community already acted on downstream
un-fenced witness / double-conferral: the Goal-entity close as the community witness with no fencing token, letting two concurrent sessions each perform a valid-looking reincorporation
cardinality-phase-skip: /goal-met (session-scoped) collapsed onto Goal close (goal-scoped) fires goal-level reincorporation from session-level separation
optional-consumer-as-un-bound-terminal-phase: the mandatory successor-proposal wired as a best-effort unordered close-event consumer, leaving the rite's final witness un-fired
concurrent-cohort strand: strategized-collapse with two chain definitions and no fence/resolution-ceremony, stranding in-flight runs as double-/no-status subjects
hollow-witness-outliving-authority: interphase retirement preserving the daily statusline witness while cutting the phase authority, so the community attests to a status no living authority confers

no-checkpoint-cannot-resume-the-rite: a single open/closed bit instead of per-step checkpoints, so an interrupted terminal sequence either re-runs (double-witnessing) or marks closed with an unfinished passage
failure_mode: Declines any finding whose defect is purely transactional -- a race, a duplicate write, a missing checkpoint, a compensation gap -- with no stranded-subject, missing-separation, un-witnessed-conferral, or pollution consequence; that belongs to fd-orchestration-terminal-consistency alone.

Declines any finding whose defect is purely ritual -- a skipped phase, an un-witnessed status, a pollution, an interrupted rite -- that does not depend on a transactional mechanism (retry, fencing, provisional-accept, concurrent writers, checkpoint, consumer-optionality, consistency-window) to arise; that belongs to fd-liminal-rite-passage alone.

Does not evaluate whether the formation interview elicited the RIGHT goal (fd-elicitation-ritual-design), nor the DefaultChain change / three-way transition-ownership sequencing as a migration-engineering problem (fd-kernel-phase-migration), nor ownerless-drift and succession-across-custodians over long horizons (fd-waqf-perpetual-trust); it touches those seams only where a status crossing is simultaneously transactionally-and-ritually defective.

By construction cannot report a finding that only one parent frame would surface -- the intersection-only constraint is the lens's failure mode when the transaction frame and the rite frame do not actually cross at a specific status crossing in the doc.
